name: search_sap_objects
description: Search SAP programs, global classes, interfaces, function modules and packages by name pattern. Returns bounded metadata, no source.

name: read_sap_object
description: Read active SAP source and revision. Class main source contains global definition/implementation; read local includes separately when needed.

name: read_sap_method
description: Read only one implementation method of an active SAP global class. Prefer this over read_sap_object when explaining a known method or following a call from a transpiler run. Returns up to 120 lines by default; use from_line to page a longer method. For definitions, class-wide structure or editing, use read_sap_object.

method_name.description: Exact ABAP method name, including IF_INTERFACE~ prefix where applicable.

from_line.description: 1-based line within the method; defaults to 1.

limit.description: Maximum method lines returned; defaults to 120.

name: create_sap_object
description: Prepare a new SAP source object and open its diff for user review. Does NOT write SAP. Supply complete source. FUNC requires an existing function group; this tool creates source only, not FM parameter metadata.

name: modify_sap_object
description: Change one source unit: the complete replacement source goes into its editor tab, unsaved. Read first; pass its revision. Does NOT write SAP - the user saves with Save & Activate or Review & Activate. Refused if the tab holds unsaved edits SAP does not have.
